three_review_sets.interpretation: Matching review verdicts do not establish factual correctness or human agreement.

methods.criterion_review_counting: Each review counted once per disposition for each criterion. A review with conflicting multiple findings can contribute to more than one disposition; flagged IDs preserve that distinction. Denominators are completed reviews and reviews reporting the criterion checked; not correctness or consensus.
